reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Absolutely love this scent, would just honestly love for it to be longer lasting lol. Febreze brand is always reliable and these sprays are decently priced. I will definitely be purchasing more, the design is cute, and it is recyclable which is a plus.
reviews.author: vegab

reviews.title: Iykyk
reviews.text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] This Febreze is by far my favorite! My husband fell in love with it. We use a ton of Febreze products and are all about the smell-good stuff. Apple Mango Sunshine is such a perfect name for this scent because that's exactly what it smells like! I love it, he loves it, we all love it!
reviews.author: amnik669

reviews.title: Smells Spectacular
reviews.text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] This spray lives in my bathroom and holy SMOKES. This scent is absolutely amazing and it lasts for awhile! It's great for covering up smelly poops.. hehe.. and other bad smells like a litter box or animal accidents. No matter what you use it for, you're bound to love the smell like I do.

reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Love this!! Great package and design, very effective. Makes it smell great and scent is strong and long lasting. Good value. Love this brand overall
reviews.author: devoreeallison

reviews.title: Fresh clean scent!!
reviews.text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Febreeze air mist apple mango smells great! I love my home to smell fresh and clean. This does that. The spray is a nice fine mist. Have been using febreeze for a long time. This is the first with this scent. Apples and mangos. Such a springtime scent. Highly recommend if you like your home to smell good!
reviews.author: maliad10

reviews.title: Fantastic for freshening up a room
reviews.text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] This is a delightful and refreshing scent that brightens up any room. The blend of apple and mango creates a sweet, fruity aroma that's not overpowering. It's great for quickly eliminating odors and leaving a pleasant fragrance behind.
reviews.author: mcavenagh

reviews.title: Leaves my rooms smelling tropical!
reviews.text:
[This review was collected as part of a promotion.] I've used fabreeze before, as well as other room deodorizers. Fabreeze tends to be a better scent wise. The mango sent is perfumed, but pleasant. It lasts in room and adds.a nice touch that blends away well.
I would recommend.if one wants a perfumed scent over a neutral one.

reviews.title: Smells apple-ly but works!
reviews.text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] This smelled more like apple than mango. I was hoping for a nice balance, but it's okay because the spray works well! We had a lingering firepit smell in our living room from leaving windows open, and this took care of it right away!
